test_coverage_notes: This file is a serialization utility; direct tests may exist in unit tests for JSON serialization or Writer. Validation is limited to type dispatch (value.type()), so tests should cover all Json::Value types (null, int, uint, real, string, bool, array, object). Gaps: No explicit error handling for unknown types; no validation of value contents beyond type. Test files likely: test/json/Json_test.cpp, test/json/Writer_test.cpp, or similar. If these do not exist, coverage may be lacking for edge cases (e.g., deeply nested structures, unusual types).
